Do we want to make chapter summaries, or is that overkill? Finding some redlinks for <nowiki>{{bwb|24}}</nowiki>, etc. Trying to think how best to deal with them.. -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 15:08, 15 June 2025 (UTC)

:I think chapter summaries make sense, just not at the level of detail as the plot summaries for the regular books. Some of them maybe could even be stub pages that link to wiki pages that are significantly relevant to the content of the chapter. Chapter pages might also be a useful place to note errata. Since the BWB is mostly a lore dump and the wiki is basically inherently a "summary" of the BWB, chapter summaries don't need to be really detailed, but even just listing the subject matter for each chapter could be useful (if only for helping users less technically proficient than ourselves find what they're looking for in the book itself).
